sets.no: Each tray has 7. Count 7, then 7 more.

sets.q: Theo has 7 red cars and 3 blue cars. How many cars in all?

sets.no: Is there a clue word? Are the groups the same size?

sets.q: There are 5 vases. Each vase has 3 tulips. Which tells the number of groups?
sets.why: The vases are the groups. There are 5.
no: 3 is how many tulips are in each vase.
15 is all the tulips, not the groups.

sets.q: The farm puts 5 apples per basket. There are 4 baskets. Which number sentence fits?
sets.why: Per basket means each basket gets 5. 4 groups of 5: 4 × 5 = 20.
no: Every basket gets 5 apples, so the groups are equal. Multiply.
There are 4 baskets, not 5.

Count them both. 7 × 2 = 14 and 2 × 7 = 14.
